item.tib: dbal gsas gsang ba'i thugs rgyud gsas mkhar ti ka g.yu rdzongs
item.coloph: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs khro bo rtsod pa bzlog pa'i yang snying bcud du phyung ba/ yang gsang thugs rgyud ti ka g.yu rdzongs (rdzong) zhes bya ba/ yum sras gshen gsum gyi lung don/ stag la me 'bar gyi thugs bcud/ yongs su dag pa'i dmar byang / lha klu mi gsum (gyi) man ngag lho yi gshen gsum gyi bka' lung*/ zhang zhungagashen gsum gyis zab thus/ rgya bod sgom gshen gsum gyi thugs dam/ phrom bod zhang gsum gyi (gyis) zhus don/ se lde me gsum gyi snyan (snyan) rgyud/ byin rlabs rgyud pa'i gshen gsum gyis mdzad srol/ btsun pa kun dga'i ming gi dngos grub/ ma 'ongs sems can yongs kyi lha skal/ rjes 'jug sgrub gshen yongs kyi spyod yul zhes bya ba'o//
